verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents its own history import: by default it imports the last 90 days, there is a dedicated 'import full history' how-to, and it has migration guides from Gmail, Spark and Superhuman. A user reports aliases and signatures also carried over. However, community reports say the free plan stops at 90 days of pre-signup history and the product works only with Gmail accounts, so mail from other providers or IMAP isn't covered. Missing for 10: contact import, support for non-Gmail/IMAP providers, full-history import beyond 90 days on all plans, and detail on the full-history process.
